auth.title: Sign in to your bank
auth.intro: We confirm your identity with a one-time code. We will never ask for your password.
auth.documentNumberHint: Letters, digits, and hyphens, 4 to 20 characters.
auth.documentNumberInvalid: Check the number: use 4 to 20 letters, digits, or hyphens.
auth.phoneLast4Hint: From the phone registered with the bank.
auth.codeHint: 6 digits. You can paste the whole code.
auth.codeExpired: The code expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.wrongCode: The code is not correct or the details do not match.
auth.locked: For your security, sign-in is locked after several failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
auth.expiredBody: For your security we end the session after a period without activity. Sign in again and we will pick up where you left off.
auth.stepUpBody: This action changes something in your account, so we need a new code.
auth.stepUpFailed: We could not open the verification.
auth.thesisUnderstand: It understands your message, in Spanish or Portuguese.
auth.thesisDecide: The bank's rules decide, and we only report actions we have verified.
auth.thesisEscalate: When something needs a person, we say so and hand your case over.

home.heading: How can we help today?
home.intro: The assistant answers from your account data and the bank's policies. When something needs a person, it says so and hands your case over.

topics.account_inquiryBody: Balances with their as-of date, payment status, and statement summaries.
topics.card_supportBody: Card status and a protective block. Unblocks and replacements go to a person.
topics.disputeBody: Charges you do not recognize and the status of your case.
topics.creditBody: Products and an indicative eligibility result. Never an approval.
topics.account_inquiryExample: What is the balance of my accounts?
topics.card_supportExample: What is the status of my card?
topics.disputeExample: I do not recognize a charge on my card
topics.creditExample: Which personal loans do you have?

console.heading: Overview
console.agentBody: You handle structured handoffs: verified facts, actions taken, the policy basis, and open questions. Never the full transcript.
console.evaluatorBody: You review execution records and offline evaluation results, always with the per-workflow numbers next to the total.

escalation.title: Your case went to a person on the team

heading.synthetic_notice: Synthetic eligibility guide (demonstration): this is not a credit decision.
heading.reasons: Reasons, with the rule behind each one:

outcome.indicatively_eligible: Under the synthetic rules, your profile indicatively meets this product's conditions.
outcome.not_eligible: Under the synthetic rules, your profile does not meet this product's indicative conditions for now.
outcome.review_required: Your case needs a review by a person from the credit team.
outcome.insufficient_data: We are missing information needed to give you a guide.

reason.self_service_product: The product supports an automatic guide.
reason.product_requires_human_assessment: This product needs an assessment by a person from the team.
reason.credit_score_present: A credit score is on record.
reason.missing_credit_score: No credit score is on record.
reason.credit_score_meets_minimum: The credit score reaches the product's minimum.
reason.credit_score_below_minimum: The credit score is below the product's minimum.
reason.income_currency_mismatch: The available income is in another currency and cannot be compared.
reason.payment_to_income_within_maximum: The estimated monthly payment is within the maximum relative to your income.
reason.payment_to_income_above_maximum: The estimated monthly payment exceeds the maximum relative to your income.
reason.days_past_due_within_maximum: There are no arrears on your credit products.
reason.missing_days_past_due: There is no information about arrears on your credit products.
reason.days_past_due_present: There are arrears on your credit products.
reason.tenure_meets_minimum: Your time as a customer reaches the minimum.
reason.missing_tenure: There is no information about your time as a customer.
reason.tenure_below_minimum: Your time as a customer is below the minimum.
reason.amount_within_product_range: The amount and term are within the product's range.
reason.amount_outside_product_range: The amount is outside the product's range.
reason.term_outside_product_range: The term is outside the product's range.
reason.purpose_not_offered: The product does not accept that purpose.
reason.amount_above_review_threshold: The amount is above the human review threshold.
reason.risk_estimate_unavailable: The risk estimate is not available.
reason.risk_band_acceptable: The risk estimate is in an acceptable band.
reason.risk_band_not_acceptable: The risk estimate is outside the product's acceptable bands.
reason.risk_interval_clear: The estimate's uncertainty is not close to a boundary between levels.
reason.borderline_risk_interval: The estimate's uncertainty is close to a boundary between risk levels.

missing_fact.monthly_income: Your monthly income (you can declare it in this conversation).
missing_fact.max_days_past_due: The arrears information of your credit products.

uncertainty.indicative_only: This is an indicative guide based on synthetic rules and may change after a human review.
uncertainty.borderline_estimate: The risk estimate is close to a boundary, so the result is uncertain.
uncertainty.missing_information: Without the missing information we cannot give a guide.
uncertainty.estimate_unavailable: No risk estimate was available, so the result is uncertain.

review_path.submit_for_human_review: If you like, we can record your application for review by a person from the credit team.
review_path.request_human_contact: If you like, a person from the credit team can review your case and contact you.
review_path.provide_missing_information: If you give us the missing information, we can give you a new guide; you can also ask to speak with a person.

glass.title: Execution record
glass.intro: What the system understood, which rules decided, and which actions were checked, turn by turn.
glass.reasoningNote: Model reasoning is not shown, by design. Decisions are explained by rules, sources, and records.
glass.emptyBody: Each assistant answer leaves its record here: state, rules, sources, and tools.
glass.notFoundTitle: We could not find that record
glass.notFoundBody: The conversation does not exist or is not yours.
glass.error: We could not load the record
glass.showMessage: Show the message in the chat
glass.belowThreshold: Below the threshold: a clarifying question was asked.

llmStatus.fallback: unavailable: the deterministic path was used

glass.noUnderstanding: No model took part in this turn.
glass.preCheckNote: Evaluated before the records are read; rules without facts are evaluated again afterwards.
